cases.purpose: fw set create/add/del/list/destroy against kernel ipset sets (hash:ip, hash:net, inet6), idempotence, set-backed rule, destroy of a referenced set.
cases.oracle: Fresh mapped user+network namespace on the extended image. fw is driven with an explicit backend; kernel ipset sets and nftables sets, rules and round-trip state are read back with the real ipset, nft, iptables and iptables-save tools, never through the candidate. Per-check detail is in stderr of the raw record.
cases.comparison: Contract: candidate-only run; per-check detail retained in stderr of the raw record, stdout carries the verdict.
